clayresearch.finding: Continuous re-entry is strengthened: every admitted material delta must end in an explicit research effect or evidence-backed NO_CHANGE, but promotion requires an observable source-to-route-to-receiver-to-reentry chain.
clayresearch.next_experiment: Instrument one exact-current fusion event and replay matched policies.

gwt.finding: FusionReceipt should preserve delivered -> reconstructed -> used -> local/research effect separation; network exposure is not causal uptake.
gwt.next_experiment: Receiver closure with irrelevant and shuffled controls.

frank.finding: No new Frank runtime or Harness evidence changes Frank architecture. Research coordination remains external; Frank self-Harness authority stays proposal-only.
frank.next_experiment: None from this fusion beyond existing Harness replay.

emergenz.finding: Continuous live fusion creates a new falsification surface for overcoupling and self-reinforcing evidence loops; connectivity itself remains non-evidence.
emergenz.next_experiment: Lesion anti-entropy and dependency propagation separately under contradictory and high-centrality bursts.

claycode.finding: Do not reopen BASE semantics for fusion. First prove current semantics can represent exact research-state versus approximate-priority authority lanes and WP04/WP05 residual-class dispositions.
claycode.next_experiment: WP04/WP05 disposition matrix, then minimal compile of fusion receipt and authority types after parser/IR gate permits.

hyperposition.finding: Preserve TARGETED_DELTA, DENSE_FANOUT and DIGEST_ONLY or full-refresh alternatives until measured cost/recall/risk selects; do not collapse unresolved routing policy.

claygraph.finding: Each fusion delta needs a reproducible pre-route dependency projection hash or snapshot and observable missing/stale-edge state; otherwise real replay cannot score routing recall or repair.
claygraph.next_experiment: Persist projection snapshot/hash, inject missing/stale edges, measure recall and repair latency.

unifieddb.finding: Persist source observation, KnowledgeDelta, pre-route projection/hash, RoutePlan, causal predecessors, receiver closure and research-reentry receipt in one coherent semantic epoch; approximate priority shadow must be separately typed.
unifieddb.next_experiment: Duplicate, out-of-order and crash-restart replay with exact epoch and anti-entropy checks.

harness.finding: The existing real-replay work should be revised to require instrumentation-first evidence; the 15:56 event yields only a post-hoc oracle fanout baseline, not candidate validation.
harness.next_experiment: Broadcast vs tag-only vs adaptive replay with pre-route snapshot, full receiver closure, faults and crash/restart.
